description: Workflow gate for Bench P2 W1 — Link shortener: persistence, click analytics, rate limiting (Arm C: Invoker DAG, mixed Codex)

config.prompt:
Read SPEC.md first; it is the source of truth. This task is one step of a larger change. Implement only this step:
Record every redirect as a click (timestamp from the injectable now option, Referer or null) in a new migration, and add GET /links/:code/stats with totalClicks, lastClickedAt, and clicksByDay (UTC dates) exactly as in SPEC.md. Stats requests must not count as clicks and clicks must persist across restarts. Add tests.
Run npm test and npm run build before committing; both must pass. Commit your changes.
Do it locally: do not use Invoker, invoker-cli, or any other delegation.

Read SPEC.md first; it is the source of truth. This task is one step of a larger change. Implement only this step:
Review the whole change against SPEC.md, fill any missing test coverage for persistence, validation, analytics, and rate limiting, and update README.md to document the new endpoints and configuration.
Run npm test and npm run build before committing; both must pass. Commit your changes.
Do it locally: do not use Invoker, invoker-cli, or any other delegation.

Read SPEC.md first; it is the source of truth. This task is one step of a larger change. Implement only this step:
Replace the in-memory link Map with SQLite storage (node:sqlite) behind a migration runner that records applied versions in a schema_migrations table. Add the createApp options databasePath and the app.locals.close() hook from SPEC.md. Add a test that a link created by one app instance is readable by a new instance on the same database file.
Run npm test and npm run build before committing; both must pass. Commit your changes.
Do it locally: do not use Invoker, invoker-cli, or any other delegation.

Read SPEC.md first; it is the source of truth. This task is one step of a larger change. Implement only this step:
Add fixed-window per-IP rate limiting to POST /links only, configured by the rateLimitMax / rateLimitWindowMs options (env defaults RATE_LIMIT_MAX=20, RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS=60000) and the now option. Over-limit requests get 429 with an error body and a whole-seconds Retry-After header >= 1 and must not create links. Redirects and stats are never limited. Add tests.
Run npm test and npm run build before committing; both must pass. Commit your changes.
Do it locally: do not use Invoker, invoker-cli, or any other delegation.

Read SPEC.md first; it is the source of truth. This task is one step of a larger change. Implement only this step:
Add URL validation (absolute http or https only) and custom code validation (^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{3,32}$) returning 400, and return 409 for a duplicate custom code, exactly as in SPEC.md. Add tests.
Run npm test and npm run build before committing; both must pass. Commit your changes.
Do it locally: do not use Invoker, invoker-cli, or any other delegation.
